The contract's evidence line names GET /operator/reservations/guests/:id/summary -> 200; the restricted operator's browser cannot call that route (it needs the guests scope), so the browser-side evidence is the book-scope reservation detail that embeds the same guest summary, and the guests-scope summary 200 is the curl positive control.

frictions.description: wrangler d1 execute --json redacts column values named like secrets: OrganizationInvitation.token and Verification.secret both came back as asterisks (correct length), so the signup TOTP could not be computed from the JSON output.
frictions.resolution: Read the local D1 SQLite file directly, read-only, via sqlite3 "file:apps/app/.wrangler/state/v3/d1/miniflare-D1DatabaseObject/<hash>.sqlite?mode=ro" and computed the 6-character code with @epic-web/totp (generateTOTP returns { otp }) using the stored algorithm/digits/period/charSet.
